record.edic_text:
4796 sugchairo {soong-khah'-ee-ro}

from 4862 and 5463; TDNT - 9:359,1298; v

AV - rejoice with 6, rejoice in 1; 7

1) to rejoice with, take part in another's joy
2) to rejoice together, to congratulate

＜所＞為了…的緣故，由於，以…為理由
